Key details of the allotment are as follows:  Each Warrant is convertible into, or exchangeable for, 1 (one) fully paid-up equity share of the Company of face value of ₹10/- each at a price of ₹645/- each (including a premium of ₹635/- per warrant).  The allotment has been made upon receipt of the upfront subscription amount of ₹161.25 per Warrant, equivalent to 25% of the total issue price.

triggers.detailsText: Highlighting the progress made under the first phase of the programme, the government said 12 semiconductor projects with cumulative investments exceeding Rs 1.64 lakh crore have been approved across six states, with five of them already commencing commercial production as of October 2026. Alongside the Semicon 2.0 launch, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology approved 12 additional projects under ECMS involving projected investments of Rs 7,503 crore. The latest approvals come after clearance of 106 applications involving investments of Rs 69,548 crore announced earlier under the scheme.
